Prashant Kishor wins Bankipur bypoll; BJP to review results

Prashant Kishor won the Bankipur assembly bypoll in Bihar. The victory is being discussed as a potential turning point in Bihar politics and for the BJP. The BJP plans to conduct a booth-wise review, suspecting a shift of RJD votes to Kishor. Political parties like DMK, CPI(M), and CPI(ML) Liberation have congratulated Kishor on his win. Social media has drawn parallels to the unpredictability of Bihar's politics, referencing a clip from the web series 'Maharani'.
